sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, Line Runners is a reflex-based puzzle game that challenges players to stay on a narrow course while avoiding obstacles. The game's single-screen layout makes it easy to navigate, but the increasing tempo and complexity of patterns make it a true test of timing and reflexes. Your goal is to tap on the screen to avoid hazards and leap over gaps, all while keeping your runner balanced on the line.

As you progress through the levels, the obstacles become more frequent and difficult to avoid. Gaps open up suddenly, and spikes appear without warning, forcing you to react quickly to stay alive. But it's not just about reacting to obstacles - you also need to anticipate and plan ahead, using your knowledge of the course to stay ahead of the game.

One of the key mechanics in Line Runners is the use of timing to leap over gaps and avoid obstacles. This requires a deep understanding of the game's physics engine and a quick reflexes to succeed. By mastering the timing of your leaps, you can avoid obstacles and stay on the line, making it possible to reach new heights and unlock new levels.
